description: Test suite for absl::node_hash_map, including tests for emplace, merge, extract, insert, erase_if, and recursive type compilation.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: A recursive structure with a node_hash_map of its own type.

classes.name: RecursiveType
classes.description: A struct containing a node_hash_map of RecursiveType, used to test recursive compilation.

methods.name: Emplace
methods.description: Test for emplacing elements into node_hash_map.

methods.name: AssignRecursive
methods.description: Test for assigning a node_hash_map of a recursive type.

methods.name: MoveOnlyKey
methods.description: Test for using move-only keys in node_hash_map.

methods.name: MergeExtractInsert
methods.description: Test for merging, extracting, and inserting nodes in node_hash_map.

methods.name: EraseIf
methods.description: Test for erasing elements based on a predicate.

methods.name: NodeHandleMutableKeyAccess
methods.description: Test for mutable key access via node handles (requires C++17 launder).

methods.name: RecursiveTypeCompiles
methods.description: Test that a recursive type containing a node_hash_map compiles correctly.
